storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Romance Story
storyTemplate.description: A romance start: arrive at a coastal inn for a fresh start and decide which first connection to pursue.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The sea wind smells like salt, rain, and warm bread from the inn kitchen.

You stop at the front steps of Harborlight Inn with your luggage in hand. Lanterns glow behind the windows, voices drift from the common room, and the harbor bells mark the hour.

A new room, a new town, and a first evening are waiting. The first step is checking in.
